verifications.claim: Early 2027 Social Security COLA predictions indicate a 2.8% increase matching the 2026 adjustment.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "A separate projection from The Senior Citizens League... remains steady at 2.8 percent, unchanged from its earlier forecast. That would match the COLA beneficiaries received in 2026" (R1); "the Senior Citizens League... estimates the COLA could be 2.8% in 2027... unchanged from its forecast in March. In 2026... received a 2.8%" (R2); "The Senior Citizens League predicts the 2027 COLA will be 2.8%, the same as received in 2026" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state TSCL's early prediction is 2.8%, matching the 2026 COLA.

verifications.claim: Early estimates for the 2027 Social Security COLA were lower.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "one analyst has predicted that COLA could be 3.2 percent in 2027, up from a 1.7 percent forecast in March and a 1.2 percent estimate the month before" (R1); "That is up from a 1.7% COLA increase Johnson had forecast in March" (R2); "rising her estimate for the 2027 COLA to 3.2%, up significantly from her estimate last month... two months ago... just 1.2%... 1.7% last month" (R8, R10)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly note Johnson's early estimates were 1.2% and 1.7%, lower than current predictions.

verifications.claim: Official 2027 Social Security COLA figures are based on Q3 2026 data.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The annual COLA adjustment is calculated by comparing CPI-W data for the third quarter of the current year" (R2); "COLA is determined by the percentage increase in the Consumer Price Index... for the third quarter of the year - July, August and September" (R4); "Each year the COLA is determined by using the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners (CPI-W) for the months of July, August and September" (R6, R7); "The COLA is determined by inflation in the third quarter of the year—July, August, and September" (R8); "comparing the change in the CPI-W from year to year, based on the average of the third-quarter months of July, August and September" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources confirm official COLA uses Q3 (Jul-Sep) CPI-W data.

verifications.claim: Official 2027 Social Security COLA figures are not finalized until October 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "With several months of inflation data still to come, projections... remain fluid" (R1); "The 2027 COLA will be announced in October of this year" (R6, R7); "the official 2027 COLA can be calculated in October" (R8); "The official 2027 COLA will be released... in mid-October 2026" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Sources state official announcement is in October 2026, after Q3 data.

verifications.claim: The predicted increase for the 2027 COLA is 2.8% as of April 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Articles dated April 2026: "The Senior Citizens League... remains steady at 2.8 percent" (R1); "estimates the COLA could be 2.8% in 2027... unchanged from its forecast in March" (R2); "predicts the 2027 COLA will be 2.8%" (R4, R6, R7, R8, R10)
verifications.reasoning: TSCL's April 2026 prediction is explicitly 2.8% across sources.

verifications.claim: A 2.8% COLA would raise average checks for retired workers by about $56.60 per month.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "boost the average benefits check for retired workers by $56.60" (R4); "the average benefits check for retired workers would increase by $56.69" (R8, R10)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state ~$56.60-$56.69 monthly increase for average retired worker check with 2.8% COLA.

verifications.claim: A 2.8% COLA would raise average checks for retired workers from $2,024 to $2,081 per month.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "boost the average benefits check for retired workers by $56.60 from $2,024 to $2,081" (R4); "from $2,024.77 to $2,081.46" (R8, R10)
verifications.reasoning: Exact figures match R4; minor rounding in others confirms for average retired worker checks.

verifications.claim: The Social Security Administration will release the official 2027 Cost of Living Adjustment in mid-October 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the official 2027 COLA will not be announced until mid-October 2026" (R8); "The official 2027 COLA will be released by the Social Security Administration (SSA) in mid-October 2026" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state SSA release in mid-October 2026.
